question: Can the winter-hero sweep score 24 candidates faster while preserving the screenshot-based quality metric?
hypothesis: Caching the screenshot reference luminance and edge response will preserve the legacy pixel score within 1e-9 while reducing per-candidate metric time.

conditions.baseline: Page.captureScreenshot + base64 transfer + PNG decode + two new canvases per candidate

acceptance.parity: first candidate cached and legacy screenshot scores differ by at most 1e-9; otherwise use legacy for the whole batch
acceptance.quality: Stanford-ORB held-out and fixed winter hero remain within their existing limits
acceptance.speed: record meanHotCaptureMilliseconds, metricPath, metricParityDelta and per-candidate metricMilliseconds

decision: Direct canvas readback rejected. Retain screenshot authority; run cached luminance parity and timing on next head.

directWebGpuCanvas.result: falsified on the Windows GPU runner
directWebGpuCanvas.decision: Do not score the WebGPU canvas via a 2D drawImage. Use the PNG screenshot as the pixel authority.
